main_concerns.concern: The central claim—that an injected marker-cleanup failure flips probe ok to false—is asserted but not independently demonstrated. The displayed carrier_probe_attempt_decision signature does not accept marker_cleanup_error, so the causal mechanism is either missing from the evidence or located in an unaudited, truncated region.

The cleanup failure injection's location in the codebase is unverified. If REDCAP_TEST_INJECT_CARRIER_MARKER_CLEANUP_FAILURE is checked only in a test wrapper, CLI entry point, or special test mode rather than inside carrier_probe() or carrier_probe_attempt_decision(), the injection proves nothing about how production carrier_probe handles real marker cleanup failures. The env var name itself ("TEST_INJECT") is suspicious — production code paths shouldn't contain test-only injection points. A real marker cleanup failure would not go through an env-var-gated code path.
